name: Mixtral 8x22B
notes: PARAMS: 140.6B is the safetensors count; Mistral's post says 141B. ACTIVE: 39B is Mistral's published figure, not derived. KV: 56 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 229,376 bytes/token = 224 KiB/token, well under half of Llama 3.3 70B's 320 KiB/token despite being twice the weights and 39B active versus 70B. This is the cleanest KV-vs-active divergence in the open-weight set: 39B of active compute with 224 KiB/token of KV. Same 2-of-8 expert ratio as 8x7B but each expert is much wider (intermediate 16384 vs 14336 against a 6144 vs 4096 hidden size), which is why active params scale to 39B. 64k context per the vendor post and config.
